dedupe_keys.name: nzta state highway traffic monitoring system tms quarter hourly volumes new zealand

description: This dataset from the NZ Transport Agency's traffic monitoring system contains quarter-hourly traffic volumes on New Zealand state highways, split by vehicle class (heavy and light) and direction, from February 2022 to January 2025. It is the third volume of the series, after releases covering 2013 to 2020 and 2020 to 2022, and it comes from the agency's count sites on the state highway network. Coverage is national for state highways. The data are a collection of CSV files shared through ArcGIS Online, free under the CC-BY-NZTA 4.0 licence. Caveats: each volume is a fixed release, not a live feed, and local roads are not included. The counts support calibration of traffic and freight flow models, disruption and resilience analysis after events on the state highway network, and capacity planning. It complements national road networks elsewhere in the catalogue and is related to the WebTRIS counts for England.
name: NZTA state highway traffic monitoring system (TMS) quarter-hourly volumes, New Zealand
